matching: An item counts as a death trigger when its name matches an entry's name (or one of its aliases). match 'exact' ignores case, apostrophe style and text in parentheses; match 'contains' matches anywhere in the item's name.

triggerTypes.creature_dies_nearby: Any (often filtered) creature dies within range
triggerTypes.you_kill: You reduce a creature to 0 HP / kill it
triggerTypes.marked_target_dies: Your marked, cursed or sworn target dies or drops to 0 HP
triggerTypes.ally_or_enemy_zero_hp_nearby: Someone reduces an enemy to 0 HP near you
triggerTypes.self_would_drop_to_0: You (or an ally) would drop to 0 HP
triggerTypes.companion_dies: Your summoned or companion creature dies or drops to 0 HP
triggerTypes.death_save: A death saving throw is made or a dying creature stabilizes
triggerTypes.custom: Added by the GM from an item's context menu

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.effect: You or a creature within 60 ft regains HP equal to the dead creature's Hit Dice.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.effect: Animate the corpse as a zombie with 1 HP.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.filter: Small or larger, within range of you or your wildfire spirit
features.effect: A spectral flame appears in the creature's space for 1 minute; when a creature enters it, you can use a reaction to heal it or deal fire damage (2d10 + Wis).

features.name: Mantle of Whispers
features.effect: Capture the creature's shadow; later assume its persona for 1 hour.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.effect: Create a soul trinket.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.effect: Regain HP equal to warlock level + Cha mod (min 1).

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.effect: Move Hexblade's Curse to a new creature; no HP regained.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.effect: The spirit rises as a specter under your control until your next long rest.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.effect: Gain temp HP equal to Cha mod + warlock level (min 1).

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.filter: enemy reduced to 0 HP by you or by anyone within 10 ft of you
features.effect: Gain temp HP equal to Cha mod + warlock level (min 1).

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.filter: killed with a spell of level 1+, not construct/undead
features.effect: Regain HP equal to 2x spell level (3x for necromancy spells).

features.name: Touch of Death
features.filter: creature within 5 ft reduced to 0 HP
features.effect: Gain temp HP equal to Wis mod + monk level (min 1).

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.effect: Gain temp HP equal to 2d6 + Con mod.

features.name: Great Weapon Master
features.filter: melee weapon attack reduces creature to 0 HP (or crit)
features.effect: Make one melee weapon attack.

features.name: Great Weapon Master (Hew)
features.filter: melee attack with a Heavy weapon reduces creature to 0 HP (or crit)
features.effect: Make one attack with the same weapon.

features.name: Hunter's Mark
features.effect: Move the mark to a new creature.

features.name: Hex
features.effect: Move the hex to a new creature.

features.name: Soul Cage
features.effect: Trap the creature's soul in a tiny cage.

features.name: Finger of Death
features.effect: Rises as a zombie under your permanent command at the start of your next turn.

features.name: Negative Energy Flood
features.effect: Rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn.

features.name: Disintegrate
features.filter: target reduced to 0 HP by this spell
features.effect: Target is turned to dust; only true resurrection or wish can revive it.

features.name: Warding Bond
features.filter: caster or target drops to 0 HP
features.effect: The spell ends.

features.name: Blackrazor
features.filter: hostile creature reduced to 0 HP, not construct/undead
features.effect: Devour its soul; gain temp HP equal to its HP max. Only wish can revive it.

features.name: Oathbow
features.effect: You can choose a new sworn enemy after the next dawn.

features.name: Nine Lives Stealer

features.effect: Expend one charge.

features.name: Clone

features.effect: Soul transfers to the clone.

features.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
features.filter: wearing the ring; ring holds no soul
features.effect: Your soul enters the ring.

features.name: Contingency
features.effect: Stored spell takes effect.

features.name: Primal Companion (revive)
features.effect: Revive the beast with full HP.

features.name: Steel Defender (revive)
features.effect: Revive the defender with full HP after 1 minute.

features.name: Familiar / Steed / Summon dismissed

features.name: Relentless Endurance

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.effect: Drop to 1 HP instead.

features.name: Relentless Rage

features.limit: DC +5 each use, resets on rest
features.effect: DC 10 Con save: HP becomes 2x barbarian level.

features.name: Rage Beyond Death
features.effect: Not knocked unconscious; you die only if still at 0 HP with 3 failed saves when the rage ends.

features.name: Rage of the Gods (Revivification)

features.limit: once per long rest on success
features.effect: Cha save (DC 5 + damage taken): drop to 1 HP instead.

features.name: Mastery of Death
features.effect: Drop to 1 HP instead.

features.name: Strength Before Death

features.name: Necrotic Husk

features.name: Death Ward

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.filter: you make a death save at the start of your turn

features.name: Searing Vengeance
